summary: Qorshaha dhammaystiran ee dib-u-habaynta UI/UX iyo xallinta 18-ka cilladood (E1–E18) ee Beerta & Dhaxalka iyadoo la raacayo dukumeentiga Falanqaynta Appka, laguna darayo dhismaha APK cusub marka shaqadu dhammaato, iyadoo aan waxba laga beddelayn xisaabta Faraa'idka iyo cabbirrada 90x48m/15m/18x24m.
